what_happened: Finding (2) of this task (task-reference lint debt) was already fully resolved by dependency tasks 766/771 before this research dispatch began; re-verification confirmed check-task-references.sh still exits 0 repo-wide. No implementation work needed for that half beyond recording the closure decision.

verify-deploy.sh gate 4 (task-reference lint)'s SKIP-on-deploy-consumer guard was copy-pasted from gate 3 (doc-lint) without re-verifying the premise: check-extension-docs.sh genuinely errors without agent-system/extensions (gate 3's guard is correct), but check-task-references.sh runs a real, meaningful check in any deploy-consumer repo with zero dependency on agent-system/extensions (confirmed by direct invocation). Gate 4's guard is factually wrong and makes --only-gate 3,4 (and --only-gate 4 alone) silently exit 0 with 0 checks in every deploy-consumer repo this system deploys into -- not specific to specs/**-only phases. Recommended fix recorded in the research report for the plan phase to execute.

Planning re-measured three verify-deploy.sh baselines directly (14 checks no-flag against this repo; 0 checks under --only-gate 4; 3 real checks under --only-gate 3,4 against the source store) instead of carrying the research report's prose, giving the final phase a falsifiable 14->15 check-count criterion.

The research report recommended a new test case asserting --only-gate 4 passes against FIXTURE_CHEAP, but FIXTURE_CHEAP builds an empty .claude/scripts/, so a de-guarded gate 4 reaches the 'check-task-references.sh not deployed' fail branch there rather than a real check. Plan Phase 4 corrects this by requiring a third fixture whose .claude is symlinked to a real deploy tree.
